outcome: Acceptance of PPIUCD CU T 380 A
symptoms (bleeding, long thread, pain in lower abdomen)
cohort: The study included 680 women who had PPIUCD inserted either after vaginal delivery or during caesarian section at a tertiary care hospital in India.
finding: The retention rate of PPIUCD was high at 86.33%, while spontaneous expulsion was found in 8.54% of women, and bleeding problems were the major complaint.
mod_finding: Spontaneous expulsion of IUCD was less in women who had intra-caesarian insertion compared to those who had vaginal delivery insertion.
